notes: Finds many more device names. Network Scanner now asks every device directly over mDNS for all the services it offers, not just a fixed list of 28 types, so speakers, TVs, phones and smart home devices that advertise other services now show their names, models and hostnames. Devices that answer only that query are now found too. Names, types and models are also remembered between scans, so a device that's quiet on one scan keeps the name it gave before.
